autonomy_goal: Use real or controlled elevator images to decide whether the OpenCV baseline can safely feed assisted delivery state gates.

repository_material_search_result.why_fixture_is_not_accepted: PGM fixtures are deterministic software guards and do not represent camera perspective, lens angle, elevator lighting, reflections, display exposure, people occlusion, or threshold geometry.

required_samples_before_field_eval.note: Samples may carry multiple taxonomy tags, but every tag minimum must be satisfied with resolved JPEG/PNG/WebP/BMP real or controlled elevator images.

collection_requirements: Use non-motion collection first; do not send base motion commands while collecting this image set.
Record site_ref, camera_ref, route_ref, collector, time window, lighting/reflection notes, and safety notes.
Cover elevator hall outside, inside car, threshold/door-open, door-closed, target floor display, non-target floor display, safe exit, unsafe exit, low light, glare, occlusion, and tilted frames.
Keep original image files and manifest under an evidence path; run checker before OpenCV eval.
manual_takeover_strategy_until_unblocked: If door_state is not open, wait or request operator help.
If inside_outside is uncertain, stop and request operator confirmation.
If target_floor_candidate does not match target_floor, keep waiting and ask a human to confirm floor.
If safe_to_exit is not safe or confidence is below min_confidence, stop and require manual takeover.
Always persist image_ref, uncertain_reasons, thresholds, and not_proven fields into task records before any assisted delivery decision.
why_o10_o2_cannot_increase: No real or controlled elevator image manifest exists in the repository.
The only evaluated images are software fixture PGM files.
OpenCV FP/FN metrics from fixtures do not measure real elevator camera false positives, false negatives, display confusion, lighting robustness, or floor confirmation.
Without field eval, behavior integration must stay fail-closed and cannot support delivery-readiness chain progress.
next_required_evidence: Backfill a resolved trashbot.elevator_image_manifest.v1 with real or controlled elevator image files.
Run the template checker and reach ready_for_opencv_eval or ready_for_eval_needs_more_labeled_samples.
Run OpenCV eval and attach FP/FN/uncertain, thresholds, confusion, and manual takeover summary.
Only after a real/controlled eval artifact exists may Robot Software consume it in the elevator state runtime chain.
